title: 11th Sitting of Second session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/11/2/2026).

Question by Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir to the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Skills Development Dr Ismail Shafeeu: why has no progress been made on the promised new school building in B. Kamadhoo, and when in this term will the work start and finish so students can use it?

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nomination of an ambassador of the Maldives to the Kingdom of Belgium and the European Union, under Article 115(d) of the Constitution and Article 14 of the Foreign Service Act (Law No. 20/2021), is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
First reading of the bill to amend the Waste Management Act (Law No. 24/2022), submitted on behalf of the government by Ungoofaaru MP Ibrahim Shifaz.
Preliminary debate on the bill to amend the Waste Management Act (Law No. 24/2022), submitted on behalf of the government by Ungoofaaru MP Ibrahim Shifaz.

Report of the Foreign Relations Committee on the President's nominations of non-resident ambassadors to the Republic of South Africa, the Czech Republic, the Islamic Republic of Mauritania and the Republic of Kenya.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting questioned the education minister on the Kamadhoo school, sent an EU and Belgium ambassador nomination to committee, introduced and began debating the Waste Management Act amendment bill, and took a committee report on four non-resident ambassadors.
